item.description: The shots were not falling for Maura Gilroy Thursday night. So, she made sure they did Friday.

item.title: Big 5 Basketball: Sharma’s 5 3-pointers lead No. 19 Saint Louis over La Salle
item.description: Ishan Sharma came off the bench to score 15 points on five 3-pointers as No. 19 Saint Louis beat La Salle 82-58 on Saturday for a 17th straight win.

item.title: Girls Basketball: Jennings scores 47 to lead Conestoga over Radnor in double OT
item.description: Ryann Jennings poured in 47 points and buried a buzzer-beating 3-pointer in OT as No. 1 Conestoga beat Radnor in a Central League semifinal, 61-56.

item.title: Brad Arnold, lead singer of Grammy-nominated rock band 3 Doors Down, dies at 47
item.description: Arnold's death comes months after he announced that he had been diagnosed with Stage 4 kidney cancer.

item.title: College Basketball: O’Hara grad Quinn helps La Salle past Fordham
item.description: Cardinal O’Hara All-Delco Joan Quinn registered 13 points, six rebounds, three assists and a game-high four steals as La Salle cruised past Fordham, 70-53, Saturday afternoon.

item.title: High Schools: Latorre, Doyle win titles at Interboro Tournament
item.description: Franco Latorre and Aidan Doyle won titles as Interboro finished second at its eight-team Interboro Tournament on Saturday. Latorre won all three of his matches by fall, including a pin of Academy Park’s Joel Omo-Osagie in the 189-pound final. Aidan Doyle scored a 20-17 decision over Daniel Agbemehia of AP in the 215-pound finale. Ryan Rossiter was the runner-up at 160 pounds, as was Greg Ferrari at 285.
